# Journal rule (bizmis-journal)

When a journal-worthy Bizmis moment happens (decision or reversal with its
rationale, struggle or dead end, ship event, real numbers or external event, idea
or doubt), SUGGEST journaling it in one line ("Worth journaling? — <moment>").
Only after Oriol approves, read the canonical spec and follow it exactly:
`~/Projects/Bizmis/bizmis-operations/.claude/skills/bizmis-journal/SKILL.md`
Explicit invocation ("journal this" / the /journal command) skips the suggestion
step: go straight to hole-filling questions (if needed) and the write.

Fallback micro-contract, only if that file is unreachable (e.g. cloud session of
another repo):
Create ONE Notion page per entry in data source
`collection://4a60c368-a262-44a8-ac56-6ddb33a1070e` (📔 Journal database
`a2ca009b-59c2-4364-a5e2-503c9860e90e` under Bizmis Docs). Properties: Headline
(specific one-liner), Date (now, datetime), Source (cowork|claude-code|cursor|
routine|manual), Areas (Operations|Product|Business, Linear definitions), Entry
types (🎯 Decision, 🔄 Reversal, 🧗 Struggle, 🚀 Ship, 📊 Numbers, 💡 Idea, ❓ Doubt,
🌍 External event), Story potential (high|medium|low), Mined=unmined. Body: facts,
then verbatim quotes (Oriol's exact words, typos included; exact error messages;
exact numbers), then refs as links. NO MINIMUM LENGTH: two lines and a quote is a
complete entry. Never pad with the drafting/iteration process (unless the iteration
is itself the story) or by restating the artifact; entries grow by appending later
developments, not by padding at birth. Never rewrite existing entries, only append.
No AI-sounding prose, no em dashes, no wrap-up sentences. Never write secrets,
tokens, EA codes, or third-party personal data.

<!-- bizmis-journal:end -->

# Copy changes keep SEO and GEO in sync (rule)

Any change to what the site says, including landing copy (`src/i18n/messages/*`
`landing.*`), FAQs (`src/data/faqs.ts`), prices (`src/data/planPrices.ts`),
Early Access terms, product claims or a new public page, must leave these current
in the same commit:
- `public/llms.txt` and `public/llms-full.txt` (GEO; generated at build from the
  same sources, so check the hand-written intro template when positioning changes)
- `src/seo/site.ts` titles and descriptions for every page in all 5 locales, and the
  JSON-LD (prices and FAQPage come from the data files)
- a new public page also needs its `src/seo` entry and a `vercel.json` route, or it
  returns 404

After editing, run `npm run build` and diff `dist/llms*.txt` and the affected
prerendered heads. Copy rules: no em dashes, no unsourced claims or numbers.
